audioOnly.semantics: Full pinned project mix. WAV preserves Float32 samples; AAC conversion and packet padding are separate from project duration. No automatic treatments or video preparation.

hevc.semantics: HEVC Main SDR opaque MP4 through the native encoder. Admission does not establish encoder readiness; requested combinations undergo the same preflight as output. H264 level and entropy controls are unavailable.

encodedAudio.semantics: Native AAC converter capabilities by format and strategy; actual writer validation remains authoritative for each combination. Variable strategy uses quality rather than bitrate.

resampling.reason: The writer rejects explicit algorithm selection during encoding; a separate conversion stage is required

semantics.bitrate: Requested encoder rate, not measured file bitrate; static content may be much smaller.
semantics.keyframes: Maximum frame and time spacing; zero requests automatic/no-limit behavior. Scene changes may add keyframes.
semantics.optionalControls: Null openGop, prioritizeSpeed or spatialAdaptiveQuantization leaves that optional property to the selected encoder, including encoders that do not implement it.
semantics.quality: Codec quality target, not lossless or a guaranteed pixel error.
semantics.lookAheadFrames: Suggested analysis window, not an exact retained-frame count. Null lets the encoder choose. An explicit value with quality 1 is rejected because the encoder would ignore it.
semantics.audio: Encoded AAC conversion follows internal 48000 Hz stereo composition mixing; AAC packet padding is distinct from project duration.
semantics.geometry: Canvas dimensions and rational frame rate belong to the composition.
semantics.backend: Top-level video availability describes the default encoder; encoderSelection lists individual encoders. Null support means the SDK did not report writability. Incompatible combinations are rejected by encoder preflight; no substitution.

maxSliceBytes.reason: Requires a supporting encoder and a verified authored control; unavailable in this output path

referenceBufferCount.reason: Requires a supporting encoder and a verified authored control; unavailable in this output path

encoderSelection.semantics: The same selection specification is enforced by preflight and the actual writer. Successful output proves acceptance of the policy, not observed encoder telemetry. Preferred GPU selection permits fallback; required selection does not.
unavailable: Low-latency rate control belongs to realtime encoding
